response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong, versatile senior/staff-level engineer with deep open-source, Linux, and full-stack experience, but he lacks the explicit team-leadership and technical-management track record the role requires, has no Python in his skill set, and critically only has 'Basic' German against a strict C1 minimum for a client-facing German consulting role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Strong open-source and Linux background, including founding and maintaining his own OSS platform (GISCollective)
Demonstrated ability to learn new domains quickly and communicate/teach (workshops, talks, mentoring at conferences)
concerns: German proficiency listed as 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum for client advisory work
No clear evidence of formal team leadership, project management, or client-facing architecture advisory experience — career is almost entirely IC/staff-level
No mention of Python, UML, or formal requirements/security/compliance experience, all of which are explicitly required or desired

key_factors.factor: German language level (Basic vs required C1)
Lack of demonstrated team leadership/management experience
Strong open-source/Linux technical depth and adaptability
